{{Quote|Hmm, not much meat on this one. I couldn't possibly give you more than ten credits."<br />"Look buddy, can't you see that this is an ambush? Now beat it! I'm not for sale!"<br />"Hmph. Belligerent, too. Eight credits.|Quad-Lo appraises Lando Calrissian|<ref name="marvel59" />}}
'''Quad-Lo''' was a short, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who frequented the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] ''[[Bazarre]]'' during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Quad-Lo attempted to purchase the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] after he arrived on ''Bazarre'' to carry out a weapons deal, assuming him to be someone's property&mdash;however, [[Orion Ferret]], the station's owner, swiftly corrected Quad-Lo and sent him away.<ref name="marvel59" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quad-Lo appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 59|''Star Wars'' 59]], written by [[David Michelinie]] and illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]], and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel59" />
